summary.content:

• **AI Spotlight**: Has vibe coding made open source the new normal for synths?

• **Security Alert**: Satellites Have a Ground-Level Cybersecurity Problem
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, BBC Technology, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 65 articles published in the last 24 hours
